usage: cox runs cause [-h] [--note NOTE] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--profile PROFILE]
                      run_id task_id {ticket,code,harness,unknown}

positional arguments:
  run_id
  task_id
  {ticket,code,harness,unknown}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --note NOTE           free text kept beside the cause
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   override: resolve task records here instead of the profile's workspace_dir
  --profile PROFILE
